answer: An extra identity counts only after a head with an unpaid claim burns that share at k times this epoch's per-head unit, k = extras it activated. Bound to both keys, it cannot be lent, split, or reused. A lone head keeps its unit. The second face costs 1 unit the real head could have claimed, the third 2, the tenth 9: each new fake costs more of the attacker's own payout than the last. Struck at this close, the unit cannot be pre-aged; refuse and the extra id drops. Keys on the tundra stay cheap until a zephyr of new faces is forced through one sponsor, cutting its yarrow of unpaid shares.
